parsed.title: Paywall Fallback Swipes
parsed.oneLiner: Provide non-paying users with limited base model swipes in exchange for engagement when they decline a premium paywall.

newMechanic.name: Base Model Swipes
newMechanic.description: A new consumable resource allowing limited interactions with a cheaper, base AI model. These are tracked per user, refresh daily, and are distinct from premium 'frontier model swipes'.
newMechanic.whyNeeded: To provide a valuable, low-cost rewarded item to non-paying users as an alternative to direct subscription, without cannibalizing the core premium offering.

parsed.trigger: Fires immediately after the user taps the decline option ('Close paywall' on s03 or 'Not now' on s04) on either Janitor Plus paywall.
parsed.eligibility: Non-paying, non-subscribed users who dismiss the premium subscription offer from s03 or s04.

offer.title: Want 3 free swipes?
offer.body: Play a quick 15-second game to get 3 free swipes on our base models.

parsed.cannibalizationGuard: The offer is gated purely on paywall decline (TAX-10). It is strictly capped at 2 instances (6 swipes) per day, ensuring the premium subscription's 'generous monthly swipes' promise remains a far superior, frictionless option. Rewards a cheaper 'base model swipe' instead of premium 'frontier model swipes'.

guardrails: Paywall s03 and s04 purchase conversion rate
kpis.holdout: Run a 5% user-level holdout group for 28 days to measure downstream subscription cannibalization and net revenue lift.

risks: Slight risk of micro-cannibalization among users who only need a couple of extra swipes per day, mitigated by the low daily cap.
Potential fatigue if users repeatedly see the offer on every paywall dismissal, mitigated by the 12-hour cooldown.

newScreens.change: Create an overlay modal containing the fallback invitation, containing the reward description, action length, and primary/secondary button layouts.

newElements.change: Primary button labeled 'Play Game' that launches the Simula mini-game on tap.
An equally legible secondary button labeled 'No thanks' that dismisses the fallback offer and routes the user back to their profile.
Text element displaying 'Your Swipes: {base_swipes} left today'. Initially 0 for free users.

callouts.text: User taps 'Not now' to decline subscription.

storyboard.caption: Today, when a user declines Janitor Plus on either paywall screen (s03 or s04), they are returned directly to their profile menu with no premium features.

callouts.text: Intercepting decline tap to trigger the fallback offer.

storyboard.caption: We introduce a product change that intercepts paywall decline actions from both s03 and s04 to offer a restricted sample of base model swipes.
The fallback modal ns1 appears, explicitly offering 3 free base model swipes for playing a 15-second game.
The user plays an interactive 15-second mini-game powered by Simula's SDK.

callouts.text: User gets 3 base model swipes credited. Counter visible on Profile menu.

storyboard.caption: Upon REWARD_VERIFIED, 3 base model swipes are credited, and the user is redirected to s02 where the new swipe counter is visible.
